analyses.title: Age Pyramid

omissions: Alternate ggcharts renderer and bespoke color/theme settings
Interactive exploration; native static pyramid implemented

analyses.methods: Plot only: counts and percentages by age band and sex, drawn as an age pyramid.

analyses.title: Alluvial Diagrams
analyses.methods: Plot only: alluvial/Sankey flow diagrams (easyalluvial / ggalluvial) with an optional flow-count table.

analyses.title: Benford Analysis
analyses.methods: Benford first-digit or first-two-digit test: digit frequencies vs log10(1+1/d), chi-square goodness of fit, MAD with Nigrini conformity labels, mantissa arc test, and the largest-deviation suspects.

analyses.title: Categorize Continuous Variables

coverage.numerical: 140 frozen-R binning fixtures; independent exhaustive Jenks partitions; saved-column protobuf checks
coverage.gui: fresh-engine run, ordinal saved column and .omv reopen verified; category plot export pending
coverage.compatibility: new Python entry point; original R module retained
omissions: Seeded Jenks subsampling when n > 20000 and distinct values > 3000
Original histogram with boundary lines (current plot shows category counts)
Original HTML styling; exported R code applies frozen displayed boundaries

analyses.methods: Data transformation: bins a continuous variable (equal width, quantiles, manual, mean +/- SD, median, Fisher-Jenks via classInt) into a new column, with a frequency table.

analyses.title: Single Variable Quality Check

coverage.numerical: 66 independent base-R fixtures; 211 Python tests and 600 R expectations pass
coverage.gui: macOS arm64: installed 0.3.6; valid-incomplete-valid saved flags; local filter; fresh-engine OMV reopen; native PNG export

analyses.methods: Single-variable QC report: missingness, z/IQR/MAD outlier flags, distribution summary, duplicates and a missingness-run heuristic. No inferential test; the MCAR test is explicitly declared not applicable.

analyses.title: Chi-Square Post-Tests
analyses.methods: Chi-square or Fisher test of an RxC table with expected counts, adjusted standardized residuals (Bonferroni criterion), pairwise 2x2 post-hoc tests with p-adjustment, Cramer's V with a bootstrap CI, and chi-square power.
analyses.oracle: stats::chisq.test ($statistic, $expected, $stdres); stats::fisher.test (2x2 is exact in both; for RxC R uses the exact network algorithm while scipy defaults to Monte Carlo); stats::p.adjust; pwr::pwr.chisq.test; boot::boot.ci

analyses.title: Cross Tables
analyses.methods: Table formatting: grouped descriptive cross-tables via gtsummary, arsenal, finalfit or tangram, with their embedded tests (chi-square/Fisher, t/ANOVA/Kruskal), q-values and an SMD table.

analyses.title: Multi-Variable Visual Quality

coverage.numerical: 32 independent base-R profile/duplicate fixtures; strict threshold, missing-code and geometry checks
coverage.gui: fresh-engine native tables/maps, local paging/filter/focus events, .omv reopen and native PNG export verified
coverage.compatibility: new Python entry point; original R module retained
omissions: Parsing-based vis_guess type detection and original visdat styling
Heuristic quality grades; native descriptive counts supplied instead

analyses.methods: Plot-first QC: visdat overview, missingness and type plots, plus duplicate and constant-variable flags. The only inferential statistic is Little's MCAR test (naniar::mcar_test).

analyses.title: Outlier Detection
analyses.methods: Outlier screening via performance::check_outliers. The default composite combines robust z (MAD), IQR (x1.7) and classical Mahalanobis (chi-square cut-off) with a vote threshold. Optional methods: ETI/HDI, robust Mahalanobis, MCD, OPTICS, LOF. Data above 10,000 rows is subsampled.
analyses.oracle: performance::check_outliers(method=c('zscore_robust','iqr','mahalanobis'), threshold=...) per-method flags and composite score

candidates: scikit-learn (MinCovDet, OPTICS, LocalOutlierFactor), only for the optional multivariate methods

analyses.title: Summary of Categorical Variables

coverage.numerical: base R table fixtures and edge-case tests
coverage.gui: fresh-engine native tables and plot verified

analyses.methods: Report formatting: categorical frequency summaries rendered as gt/gtExtras HTML, with report sentences.

analyses.title: Summary of Continuous Variables

coverage.numerical: 8 independent R summary/moments/Shapiro fixtures; native R lifecycle checks
coverage.gui: fresh-engine run, .omv reopen and native histogram PNG export verified
coverage.compatibility: new Python entry point; original R module retained
omissions: Original gt HTML styling; histogram display capped at 12 variables and 2000 aggregate bins

analyses.methods: Report formatting: continuous descriptives (mean, SD, median, IQR, skewness/kurtosis, Shapiro) rendered as gt/gtExtras HTML. pydescriptives already covers the numbers.

analyses.title: Table One
analyses.methods: Table formatting: a Table 1 via tableone, gtsummary, arsenal or janitor.

analyses.title: Variable Tree
analyses.methods: Plot only: vtree variable-tree diagram (DiagrammeR, exported as SVG).

analyses.title: Venn Diagram
analyses.methods: Plot-first: Venn and UpSet diagrams (ggvenn, ggVennDiagram, UpSetR, ComplexUpset) with set-intersection counts and a membership table.

analyses.title: Advanced Raincloud Plot
analyses.methods: plot first: ggrain raincloud with longitudinal ID lines, covariate colouring and Likert jitter. Html panels give group descriptives, a Wilcoxon (2 groups) or Kruskal-Wallis p, d-type effect sizes, change scores and responder rates, MCID/reference/CV bands and outlier filtering.

candidates: plot renderer (matplotlib not bundled; R/ggplot2 or HTML/D3 from Python data; excluded from effort)

analyses.title: Hull Plot
analyses.methods: plot only: ggforce concave hulls (geom_mark_hull, concavity/expand) around groups on an x-y scatter. Optional 95% data ellipses (stat_ellipse, multivariate t), per-group quartiles, and the smallest centroid distance in within-group SD units.

candidates: concave-hull algorithm (ggforce uses concaveman; scipy has only ConvexHull)

analyses.title: Arc Diagram
analyses.methods: plot first: arc diagram of an edge list (igraph), with nodes sized by degree or strength and sorted by name, degree or group. Network summary: density, connectedness, degree/strength, betweenness (weighted via inverse weights) and the most central node.

candidates: networkx optional (Brandes betweenness is about 40 lines of own code)

analyses.title: Bar Charts
analyses.methods: plot first: ggstatsplot::ggbarstats stacked bars with a statsExpressions subtitle: Pearson chi-square of independence with a Cramer's V CI, McNemar for paired data (no correction), a contingencyTableBF Bayes factor, and per-bar proportion (goodness-of-fit) tests. Its own Fisher exact fallback runs when expected counts are below 5; an optional ggpubr balloon plot is also offered.
analyses.oracle: statsExpressions::contingency_table, stats::chisq.test, stats::mcnemar.test(correct = FALSE), stats::fisher.test, BayesFactor::contingencyTableBF

analyses.title: Box-Violin Plots to Compare Between Groups
analyses.methods: plot first: ggstatsplot::ggbetweenstats box-violin plot. Subtitle: Welch or Fisher one-way ANOVA (omega^2/eta^2 CI), Kruskal-Wallis (epsilon^2), trimmed-means ANOVA (WRS2::t1way) or anovaBF; with 2 groups: Welch t, Mann-Whitney, Yuen or ttestBF. Pairwise Games-Howell, Student, Dunn or Yuen with p-adjustment; Levene check; ggpubr variants.
analyses.oracle: statsExpressions::oneway_anova, statsExpressions::two_sample_test, statsExpressions::pairwise_comparisons (PMCMRplus::gamesHowellTest, PMCMRplus::kwAllPairsDunnTest, WRS2::lincon), stats::oneway.test, WRS2::t1way, BayesFactor::anovaBF
analyses.menu_title: Box-Violin Plots to Compare Between Groups

analyses.title: Correlation Matrix
analyses.methods: plot first: ggcorrmat heatmap plus a correlation table from correlation::correlation: Pearson, Spearman, 20% winsorized ('robust'), or Bayesian (BF10 with an MCMC posterior-median rho). Optional partial correlations, p-adjustment (Holm by default) and CIs.

analyses.title: Dot Chart (Summary vs Reference Value)
analyses.methods: plot first: ggdotplotstats dot chart of one centrality per group (mean, median, trimmed mean or MAP), with a group summaries table. The k group summaries are tested against a reference value with a one-sample t, a Wilcoxon signed-rank (normal approximation, continuity-corrected), a trimmed-mean bootstrap-t, or a Bayes factor.
analyses.oracle: statsExpressions::one_sample_test, statsExpressions::centrality_description, WRS2::trimcibt; the signed-rank test matches scipy wilcoxon(method='asymptotic', correction=True)

analyses.title: Horizontal Box-Violin Comparison
analyses.methods: plot first: 'Horizontal Box-Violin Comparison' is ggbetweenstats with coord_flip(), plus an optional reference line. Its subtitle tests are those of jjbetweenstats: Welch/Fisher ANOVA or t, Kruskal-Wallis or Mann-Whitney, Yuen/t1way, BF, and pairwise comparisons.

analyses.title: Histogram
analyses.methods: plot first: gghistostats histogram with a centrality line. Optional one-sample test against test.value: t (Hedges' g), Wilcoxon signed-rank, trimmed-mean bootstrap-t, or ttestBF with a chosen prior. Shapiro-Wilk and a skewness interpretation; ggpubr histogram, density, QQ and ECDF panels.

analyses.title: Pie Charts
analyses.methods: plot first: ggpiestats pie, or a ggpubr donut. With one variable: chi-square goodness of fit (equal proportions or a user ratio). With two: chi-square of independence with a Cramer's V CI, McNemar for paired data, or a BF. Per-slice proportion tests, and its own Fisher fallback when expected counts are below 5.
analyses.oracle: statsExpressions::contingency_table, stats::chisq.test, stats::mcnemar.test(correct = FALSE), stats::fisher.test, BayesFactor::contingencyTableBF

analyses.title: Advanced Ridge Plot
analyses.methods: plot first: ggridges ridgeline densities (nrd0/nrd/SJ bandwidths, gradient fill). Two tables. 'Statistical Summary': n, mean, SD, median, IQR, skewness. 'Statistical Tests': pairwise Welch t, Wilcoxon with a Hodges-Lehmann CI, Yuen or ttestBF; Levene and Shapiro checks; Cohen's d, Hedges' g, eta^2 and omega^2 with CIs; percentile bootstrap CI.
analyses.oracle: stats::t.test, stats::wilcox.test(conf.int = TRUE), WRS2::yuen, BayesFactor::ttestBF, effectsize::cohens_d/hedges_g/eta_squared/omega_squared, car::leveneTest(center = median), boot::boot.ci(type = 'perc')

analyses.title: Scatter Plot
analyses.methods: plot first: ggscatterstats scatter with an lm/loess/gam smooth and ggExtra marginals. Subtitle: Pearson r (Fisher-z CI), Spearman rho, 20% winsorized r, or Bayesian BF10 with a posterior rho. Also a ggpubr scatter with stat_cor, and grouped panels.

analyses.title: Segmented Total Bar Charts
analyses.methods: plot first: ggsegmentedtotalbar 100% (segmented-total) bars with composition and summary tables. A Pearson chi-square of independence without correction runs on the summed values, reporting the largest adjusted standardized residual; a note says it is valid only when the value variable is a count.

analyses.title: Waffle Charts
analyses.methods: plot only: waffle chart of category proportions (waffle::geom_waffle), with optional facets and count or percent labels.
analyses.oracle: none (figure only); the square allocation in waffle::geom_waffle layer data

analyses.title: Box-Violin Plots to Compare Within Groups
analyses.methods: plot first: ggwithinstats paired box-violin with connecting paths. Subtitle: repeated-measures ANOVA (afex), Friedman, WRS2 rmanova or anovaBF; with 2 levels: paired t, signed-rank, Yuen or BF. Pairwise Student, Durbin-Conover or Yuen with p-adjustment. Its own 'Paired Changes' table gives mean/median/Hodges-Lehmann changes with a t, signed-rank (normal approximation) or seeded whole-case bootstrap CI, plus geometric-mean time ratios.
analyses.oracle: statsExpressions::oneway_anova(paired = TRUE), statsExpressions::two_sample_test(paired = TRUE), statsExpressions::pairwise_comparisons (PMCMRplus::durbinAllPairsTest, WRS2::rmmcp), WRS2::rmanova, stats::wilcox.test(paired, conf.int = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = TRUE), DescTools::HodgesLehmann
analyses.menu_title: Box-Violin Plots to Compare Within Groups

analyses.title: Line Chart
analyses.methods: plot first: line chart by group with CI ribbons, an lm/polynomial trend line and a reference line. A summary table, plus a 'naive' correlation table: Pearson r with CI, Spearman rho (asymptotic when tied), and OLS slope, intercept, R^2 and p, with a caveat that repeated measures are ignored.

analyses.title: Lollipop Chart
analyses.methods: plot only: lollipop chart of a value per category, with optional mean/median aggregation, sorting, highlighting and a reference line. A data summary table gives n, mean, median, SD and quartiles.

analyses.title: Raincloud Plot
analyses.methods: plot first: ggdist raincloud (half-eye + dots + box). Html panels give per-group n, mean, median, SD, IQR, skewness and kurtosis, then Shapiro-Wilk and Bartlett checks. These choose a t, Welch t or Wilcoxon test, or an ANOVA, Welch ANOVA or Kruskal-Wallis, followed by pairwise t or Wilcoxon tests with p-adjustment.
analyses.oracle: stats::oneway.test, stats::t.test, stats::wilcox.test, stats::kruskal.test, stats::pairwise.t.test, stats::pairwise.wilcox.test, stats::bartlett.test, moments::skewness, moments::kurtosis (= scipy kurtosis(fisher=False))

analyses.title: Automatic Plot Selection
analyses.methods: plot only: chooses a ggstatsplot plot from the variable types. Continuous by factor gives ggbetweenstats or ggwithinstats; continuous by continuous gives ggscatterstats; factor by factor gives ggbarstats or an alluvial plot (ggalluvial/easyalluvial). Grouped variants exist, and the statistics come from those engines.

analyses.title: Interrater Reliability
analyses.methods: Interrater reliability suite: Cohen's kappa (weighted, exact), Fleiss/Conger kappa, Krippendorff alpha (bootstrap CI), Gwet AC1/AC2, PABAK, ICC (irr::icc forms with F CIs), Lin's CCC, Bland-Altman/TDI, Kendall W, Light/Finn/Robinson/iota, Stuart-Maxwell/Bhapkar/rater bias, pairwise kappas, specific agreement, rater/case clustering, kappaSize sample size. Also lme4/ordinal mixed-effects and latent-model branches.
analyses.oracle: irr::kappa2, irr::kappam.fleiss, irr::icc, irr::kripp.alpha, irr::kendall, irrCAC::gwet.ac1.raw, irrCAC::conger.kappa.raw, DescTools::CCC, DescTools::StuartMaxwellTest, vcd::Kappa

analyses.title: Co-Testing Analysis
analyses.methods: Calculator, no data: post-test probabilities for two tests used in parallel, from sensitivity, specificity, prevalence and conditional dependence (phi covariance among diseased and non-diseased). Fagan nomogram.
analyses.oracle: the R analysis itself (closed-form Bayes, Gardner et al. 2000 covariance model)

analyses.title: Diagnostic Accuracy
analyses.methods: 2x2 diagnostic accuracy against a gold standard: sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV, LR+/-, accuracy, DOR with epiR::epi.tests Clopper-Pearson CIs, Bayes recalculation at a prior prevalence, Fagan nomogram, and a misclassified-case listing and export (Output option).

analyses.title: Diagnostic Accuracy Calculator
analyses.methods: The same diagnostic-accuracy metrics as decision, from entered TP/FP/FN/TN counts (up to three cut-offs): epiR::epi.tests CIs, prevalence scenarios, workload.

analyses.title: Combine Medical Decision Tests
analyses.methods: Combination rules for 2-3 binary tests (all, any, majority, patterns): epi.tests metrics per pattern, paired comparisons (Newcombe, Agresti-Caffo CIs), stratified association tests (Fisher, exact conditional Mantel-Haenszel), and rmultinom bootstrap optimism correction.

analyses.title: Compare Medical Decision Tests
analyses.methods: Compares 2-3 tests on the same cases: per-test epi.tests metrics, paired McNemar (exact, mid-p or asymptotic) with Holm adjustment, Newcombe method-10 CIs for paired differences, Cochran's Q, OPA with a non-inferiority margin, and stratified tables.

analyses.title: Decision Curve Analysis
analyses.methods: Decision curve analysis for a binary outcome: net benefit of model probability columns vs treat-all and treat-none over a threshold grid, bootstrap CIs and pairwise model comparisons, interventions avoided, clinical impact, standardized net benefit, relative utility, cost-benefit.

analyses.title: Clinical ROC Analysis
analyses.methods: Clinical ROC: pROC AUC with DeLong or bootstrap CIs, Youden and constrained cut-points, partial AUC, smoothing, CROC, convex hull, DeLong comparisons, multiclass (Hand-Till), calibration (logistic recalibration, Hosmer-Lemeshow, Brier, ns() spline calibration, E:O), NNT/decision impact, internal validation.
analyses.oracle: pROC::roc, pROC::ci.auc (DeLong), pROC::coords, pROC::roc.test, pROC::smooth, pROC::multiclass.roc, boot::boot.ci, stats::glm

analyses.title: Kappa Sample Size by Confidence Interval
analyses.methods: Number of subjects needed so the kappa CI excludes a lower bound, via kappaSize::CIBinary/CI3Cats/CI4Cats/CI5Cats. Goodness-of-fit model: Donner-Eliasziw for 2 raters; Altaye-Donner-Klar/Eliasziw cells for multiple raters and 2-5 categories.
analyses.baseline_title: Confidence Interval Approach for the Number of Subjects Required
analyses.menu_title: Kappa Sample Size by Confidence Interval

analyses.title: Kappa Lower Limit for a Fixed Sample Size
analyses.methods: Lowest expected kappa (lower CI bound) for a fixed N, via kappaSize::FixedNBinary/FixedN3Cats/FixedN4Cats/FixedN5Cats, same goodness-of-fit model.
analyses.baseline_title: Lowest Expected Kappa for a Fixed Sample Size
analyses.menu_title: Kappa Lower Limit for a Fixed Sample Size

analyses.title: Kappa Sample Size by Power

coverage.gui: legacy .omv reopen and power 0.8 -> 0.9 -> 0.8 rerun verified

analyses.methods: Power-based sample size for testing kappa0 against kappa1 (kappaSize::PowerBinary/Power3Cats/Power4Cats/Power5Cats, noncentral chi-square), plus an in-R Monte Carlo of the pooled-cell goodness-of-fit test for binary outcomes (seeded rmultinom, vectorized bisection ML).
analyses.oracle: kappaSize::PowerBinary, kappaSize::Power3Cats, kappaSize::Power4Cats, kappaSize::Power5Cats, and the analysis's own .simPowerBinary
analyses.baseline_title: Power Approach for the Number of Subjects Required

analyses.title: LASSO Logistic Regression
analyses.methods: Penalized logistic regression with glmnet (lasso, ridge or elastic net; cv.glmnet lambda.min/1se), bootstrap validation, pROC AUC, a coefficient-based points score with cut-offs, and a predictions export (Output option).

candidates: scikit-learn (L1 logistic; would not reproduce glmnet's lambda path and standardization exactly; not bundled)

analyses.title: Analysis Without Gold Standard
analyses.methods: Diagnostic accuracy without a gold standard for 2-5 binary tests: 2-class latent class model (poLCA EM, conditional independence), own penalized EM (Beta(2,1) priors, MAP point estimate), composite reference, all/any-positive rules, kappa between tests, case-bootstrap CIs.

analyses.title: Advanced ROC Analysis
analyses.methods: Optimal cut-point ROC with cutpointr: maximize/minimize a metric, Youden, cost/utility, loess-smoothed, bootstrapped, or normal/kernel Youden. Also pROC AUC/DeLong, partial AUC, IDI/NRI, power for AUC, Bayesian AUC, fixed-sens/spec interpolation, and meta-analysis of AUCs.
analyses.oracle: cutpointr::cutpointr (method/metric), pROC::roc, pROC::ci.auc, pROC::roc.test, pROC::coords, pROC::var, pROC::cov

analyses.title: Sequential Testing
analyses.methods: Closed-form combined Se/Sp/PPV/NPV/LR+/LR-/NNT for two tests (serial-positive, serial-negative, parallel) under conditional independence, per-population flow counts and cost per strategy; five ggplot figures (flow diagram, population flow, sensitivity analysis).
analyses.oracle: sequentialtests() itself / hand-computed identities (serial+: Se1*Se2, Sp1+(1-Sp1)*Sp2; serial-/parallel: Se1+(1-Se1)*Se2, Sp1*Sp2) for each preset

analyses.title: DateTime Converter
analyses.methods: Data wrangling, not statistics: lubridate parsing of date-time text, Excel serials (1900/1904) and Unix epochs with format auto-detection and two-digit-year rules, timezone handling, then component extraction (year, month, weekday, week, quarter, day of year) written back as Output columns, plus parse-quality tables
analyses.oracle: lubridate::ymd_hms / dmy_hms / mdy_hms and date-only variants, lubridate::with_tz, lubridate::force_tz, lubridate::week, lubridate::quarter, lubridate::yday

candidates: zoneinfo + tzdata (absent from the trimmed bundled stdlib; the free-text timezone option needs it)

analyses.title: Lasso-Cox Regression
analyses.methods: Cross-validated LASSO Cox (glmnet::cv.glmnet family='cox', lambda.min or lambda.1se, seeded folds), selected-coefficient/HR table, Harrell C (survival::concordance), cox.zph on the refit, linear-predictor risk groups with KM; CV/path/coefficient/survival plots

candidates: scikit-survival (CoxnetSurvivalAnalysis), or an own coordinate-descent Cox-lasso path

analyses.title: Multivariable Survival Analysis
analyses.methods: Multivariable Cox PH (coxph, Efron ties, interactions, strata, landmark), finalfit HR tables, cox.zph, KM and adjusted curves, risk-score groups, bootstrap optimism-corrected C, riskRegression::Score time-dependent AUC/Brier, rms::cph nomogram, Fine-Gray via survival::finegray, person-time rates, AIC/LR/drop1 model comparison
analyses.oracle: survival::coxph, survival::cox.zph, survival::finegray, finalfit::finalfit, rms::cph, rms::nomogram, riskRegression::Score, survminer::ggadjustedcurves

analyses.title: Odds Ratio Table and Plot
analyses.methods: Binary logistic regression OR table via finalfit (univariable + multivariable glm, profile-likelihood CIs, AIC/C-statistic/H&L metrics), optional Firth penalized logistic (logistf), 2x2 diagnostic metrics for one predictor (sens/spec with Clopper-Pearson, LR+/LR- by the Simel log method, as epiR::epi.tests), forest plot and rms::lrm nomogram
analyses.oracle: stats::glm(family = binomial) with stats::confint (profile), finalfit::finalfit(metrics = TRUE), logistf::logistf, epiR::epi.tests, rms::lrm

analyses.title: Outcome Organizer for Survival Analysis
analyses.methods: Data recoding: derives event indicators for overall, cause-specific, competing-risk, progression-free and multistate analyses from outcome/recurrence levels, with an event-priority hierarchy and interval/administrative censoring; writes Output columns and frequency/diagnostic tables
analyses.oracle: no statistical oracle; the recoding rules in R/outcomeorganizer.b.R

analyses.title: Single Arm Survival
analyses.methods: Single-cohort Kaplan-Meier: median survival with CI, survival at user cut points (Greenwood, survfit 'log' CI), reverse-KM follow-up, person-time incidence rates with exact Poisson CIs, competing-risk cumulative incidence (cmprsk::cuminc), Nelson-Aalen baseline hazard, landmark and date-derived follow-up; KM/cumulative-event/cumulative-hazard/KMunicate plots
analyses.oracle: survival::survfit + summary.survfit(times =) and its median/0.95LCL/0.95UCL table, cmprsk::cuminc, survival::basehaz, exact Poisson limits via stats::qchisq

analyses.title: Survival Analysis
analyses.methods: Univariable time-to-event comparison: KM by group, log-rank and Fleming-Harrington weighted log-rank (survdiff rho), pairwise tests with p-adjust, Cox HR (coxph Efron) with cox.zph, stratified and age-adjusted Cox (including age as time scale), RMST (survfit rmean), person-time rates, adjusted curves, flexsurv parametric fits, calibration, restricted cubic splines; many plots
analyses.oracle: survival::survfit, survival::survdiff(rho =), survminer::pairwise_survdiff, survival::coxph, survival::cox.zph, summary(survfit, rmean =), flexsurv::flexsurvreg

analyses.title: Survival Analysis for Continuous Explanatory Variable
analyses.methods: Continuous-predictor survival: Cox HR per unit, optimal cut-off by maximally selected log-rank statistic (survminer::surv_cutpoint / maxstat), multiple cut-offs (quantile, recursive maxstat, rpart survival tree, min-p), KM/log-rank of the derived groups, RMST, stratified Cox, cox.zph, residual diagnostics
analyses.oracle: survival::coxph, survminer::surv_cutpoint, maxstat::maxstat.test(smethod = 'LogRank'), rpart::rpart(method = 'exp'), survival::survdiff, survival::cox.zph
analyses.menu_title: Survival Analysis for Continuous Explanatory Variable

analyses.title: Comprehensive Time Interval Calculator
analyses.methods: Date arithmetic: parses start/end dates (lubridate formats), computes intervals in days/weeks/months/years on a calendar or average-length basis, landmark subsetting, negative/extreme flags, summary (mean with t CI, median, IQR) and person-time totals; writes an Output column

analyses.title: Diagnostic Test Meta-Analysis for Pathology
analyses.methods: DTA meta-analysis. Reitsma bivariate random-effects model (mada::reitsma REML/ML/fixed) gives summary Se/Sp, LRs, DOR and the SROC (mada::sroc); also PHM SROC (mada::phm), univariate logit Se/Sp heterogeneity (metafor::rma: tau^2, I^2, Q), moderator meta-regression, Deeks funnel test (weighted lm on 1/sqrt(ESS)), continuity corrections and Wilson study CIs
analyses.oracle: mada::reitsma, mada::sroc, mada::phm, metafor::rma (REML; tau2, I2, QE), stats::lm(weights = ESS) for the Deeks test

analyses.title: IHC Heterogeneity Analysis
analyses.methods: Biopsy-vs-whole-section reproducibility: ICC from mean squares with F-based CIs, robust/RMS CV, Bland-Altman bias and limits of agreement (t CIs), Spearman with Fisher-z CI, one-way variance components, ICC-precision sample-size planning (integrate/uniroot), Kruskal-Wallis across spatial compartments
analyses.oracle: psych::ICC (ICC1/ICC2/ICC3 with F CIs), stats::cor.test(method = 'spearman'), stats::t.test, stats::kruskal.test, stats::aov

analyses.title: Swimmer Plot
analyses.methods: plot only: ggswim swimmer lanes with event markers. Side tables give person-time, milestone/event counts and medians, reverse-KM follow-up, response rates with Clopper-Pearson CIs, and a Fisher group test

analyses.title: Treatment Response: Patient-Level Burden
analyses.methods: plot first: waterfall and spider plots of best % change. Tables give RECIST category counts, ORR/DCR with Clopper-Pearson CIs, person-time, a Fisher exact OR between groups, KM duration of response and reverse-KM follow-up

Experimental Observable Cutoff and ROC Explorer (Python)
Experimental Native SVG Cutoff and ROC Explorer (Python)
